'''Dreadmurk Shore''' is the name of the coastline and islands of [[Dustwallow Marsh]] between [[Theramore Isle]] and [[Northwatch Hold]] of the [[Barrens]]. It is heavily infested by the [[Murloc#Mirefin_Tribe|Mirefin murloc]] tribe. The waters are home to sea [[turtle|turtles]] and other sea creatures. The [[Defias]] have also recently suffered a shipwreck somewhere between Dreadmurk and [[Alcaz Island|Alcaz]] and have set up camp on a few islands and the beach near them.
